_readme: Project DATA (images, links, categories) and page LAYOUT. All WORDING lives in content/site.md and content/work/<slug>.md. Grid order = order of `projects`. `featuredOrder` = the Selected work rows. Per project: "wide": true (double-width card), "hidden": true (left off the site). `layout.sections` orders the home page sections; `layout.hiddenSections` hides them. The preview's Edit mode changes all of these; apply-edits.mjs writes them back here.

shotAlts: The Prismet home screen on iPhone: a dark grid of game tiles with Wordgame under Daily, and 2048, Snake, Minesweeper and Sudoku under Puzzles.
Chess on iPhone against Stockfish at about 1,200 Elo, with the pieces in their starting position, four board colour swatches, a 2D and 3D switch and an opponent difficulty slider.

A 3D Catan board in the meadow theme: hexagonal terrain tiles with numbered tokens, settlements, roads and the robber on an island surrounded by water.
Sudoku on iPhone: the Daily Grid, Easy edition, with 30 of 81 cells filled, a number pad, and New Edition and Clear Sheet buttons.
Checkers on iPhone at the start of a game: a red and black board with red and black pieces, vs AI and 2 Player options, and an opponent difficulty slider.

Helm's GPU Core face for an RTX 3080, with load, temperature and power readouts, a pixel-grid utilization history, and VRAM and disk usage bars.
